name: The Lakh MIDI Dataset (LMD)
description: The Lakh MIDI Dataset (LMD) is a large-scale collection of symbolic MIDI files designed for music information retrieval and symbolic music modeling. It comprises LMD-full (176,581 unique de-duplicated MIDI files), LMD-matched (45,129 MIDI files matched to songs in the Million Song Dataset), and LMD-aligned (45,129 MIDI files temporally aligned to 7digital audio preview clips from the MSD).
